public_rationale: The dance-only condition did not occur on the ordinary reading. Contemporaneous Reuters reporting says the presentation included footage of object handling and plant watering. That does not establish readiness for general-purpose household work, but it prevents scoring a prediction expressly conditioned on seeing only a dancing robot. Skepticism about the actual presentation would not make this conditional forecast supported.
limitations: The outcome depends on distinguishing task demonstrations from dancing or comparable physical spectacle.
A broader reading of canned demonstrations could change whether the antecedent occurred.
A contemporaneous news report is used because the primary video could not be reliably read.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If Tesla's Optimus demo shows only a dancing robot, the robotics community would rightly be skeptical about Tesla being close to a general-purpose domestic robot.
conditions: if the demo only shows a dancing robot

statement.excerpt: One more dancing robot wouldn’t tell us much about whether Tesla was close to (say) a real general-purpose domestic robot, and the robotics community would be rightly skeptical if that’s all that we saw.
statement.document_title: Top 5 reasons Tesla’s Optimus announcement may turn out be a dud

our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion identifies the September 30, 2022 presentation.
The antecedent requires a showing limited to dancing or comparable physical spectacle, without task-oriented demonstrations. Prerecorded demonstrations count as things the audience saw.
Community skepticism means a broad pattern of qualified roboticists questioning proximity to general-purpose household capability.
Rightly is an evaluative word and is not independently scored.
No separate deadline for expert reactions is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Establish that the presentation showed only dancing or comparable physical spectacle, then establish a broad pattern of expert skepticism about readiness for general-purpose domestic work.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Establish that same antecedent, then show that qualified roboticists broadly regarded the display as persuasive evidence of near-term general-purpose domestic capability.
